overview.overview:
Missouri has moved firmly into the Republican column in recent cycles. The state backed Donald Trump by about 15 points in 2020 and by roughly 18 points in 2024, a shift further right even as the nation tightened. Relative to the country as a whole, Missouri sits about 18 points more Republican, making it one of the clearer red states on the map.

For 2028, the forecast expects a Republican margin of roughly 13 points, with most plausible outcomes falling between about 4 and 22 points. Missouri's 10 electoral votes are not considered competitive at the tipping point.
overview.watch: A strong Democratic national landslide of 15 points or more would be needed to put Missouri's electoral votes in play.
key_factors: Missouri's large Republican lean of about 18 points versus the nation
A favorable national environment for Republicans worth roughly 5 points
Steady rightward drift across three consecutive presidential cycles
